title: Consolidation: From Goulash Socialism to the European Single Market

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can trace the trajectory of modern Hungarian economic history from 1946 hyperinflation to the EU single market.
I can deploy proportional, multiplicative, and rate structures (-szorosára nő, arányban áll, mértékben, ütemében) accurately in analytical writing.
I can contrast planned economy rigidities with the 1968 New Economic Mechanism and post-1990 privatization.
I can use 30 advanced B2 business, macroeconomic, and industrial terms with confidence.
